### Test Gap Description

Currently there are not tests that update the RADIUS feature via GCU, this issue tracks closing that gap.

### Test Plan

Additional test cases are added to test_aaa.py in the generic_config_updater directoy.  This test case can run on any topology and follows the same format as the existing TACACS test cases in this area.

### Test environment

Tested in both T0 and T1 topologies
